name: map-to-record-assignability-test-c5ae90a3ca/subtyping-key-not-found-p.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: the supported expression list includes Type cast expression, Mapping constructor, Member access expression and Equality expression, but does not include typeof expression.
## Module-level declarations: Supports dependently-typed functions using `typedesc` parameters with the `<>` inferred default.
### Other invocation restrictions: method-call list includes `map:get` and `value:toString` and `value:toBalString`.
reason: The case checks assigning map<Bar> to a rest-field record of Foo, preserving the underlying sealed Bar value and panicking when a new field is inserted. Its assertion helper additionally evaluates typeof expected and typeof actual, an expression form absent from the supported positive list. The narrow typedesc-parameter support does not establish typeof-expression support, so the whole case is not fully covered.
unsupported_constructs: typeof expressions in the assertion failure diagnostic
test_design_notes: The main assertion is a runtime panic on f1["cc"] = 20 after widening the static type; it requires preserving the original record's field restrictions.
The unsupported typeof expressions occur only in the assertion-failure branch; replacing that diagnostic would isolate the map/record behavior.
